facts.text: Full-time, unmarried students under the age of 21 entering the traditional College of Undergraduate Studies are required to live in on-campus housing and purchase a campus meal plan through their third year.

sources.title: Housing and Residency Requirements | CCU
sources.quote: unmarried, first-, second-, and third-year students (with CCU start terms beginning in fall 2026) under the age of 21, who are taking courses in the College of Undergraduate Studies (traditional program) are required to live on campus.
